zh-CN.title: 科研日期与成员体验统一
items: 课题和任务日期使用年月日滚轮选择，支持不设结束日期
任务分配、邀请好友和日程成员选择使用统一的可搜索勾选面板
课题详情采用聊天详情式头像排列，成员头像展示各自的头像框

en.title: Consistent research dates and member selection
items: Choose project and task dates with year, month and day wheels, including open-ended periods
Assign tasks, invite friends and select calendar members with one searchable member picker
Project details use the chat member grid, showing real avatars and individual avatar frames
